payload.title: systeminformation 5.33.15 carries GHSA-3f7j-7jwc-fxfj (high: Windows command injection in services(); affected <5.33.16, patched 5.33.16); the root-production and root-full legs of the required security-audit job are red on main since the advisory was published on 2026-10-28T22:42Z
evidence: package-lock.json:37746 (node_modules/systeminformation 5.33.15 at origin/main 645c5313, production; affected <5.33.16, patched 5.33.16)

package-lock.json:12371 (node_modules/@opentelemetry/instrumentation-host-metrics 0.6.0 at origin/main 645c5313 asks for systeminformation ^5.31.6; it sits under @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node, and no manifest declares systeminformation, so the lock is the owner)
payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): an advisory with a patched release is fixed, not excepted
payload.notes: External drift. The flaw needs Windows and every backend image is Linux; it is fixed anyway because a patched release exists inside the declared range ^5.31.6. Fix: a lock-only lift to 5.33.18 (the npm latest), npm changes only this entry, and a dependency-security floor of 5.33.16 (the first patched release) in the lock-only pattern of engine.io and body-parser.
